description: BOOT-003 (EXP-0053): the approved English for the five boot warnings, WARNING0.PIX-WARNING4.PIX. A new translation by Claude (the agent), approved by the user on 2026-11-06 under GATE-TRANSLATION (boot-warnings extension). No official English exists: the arcade has no save memory (its only shared word is the region screen's title 'WARNING'). Terms from the Sega Saturn BIOS (sega_101.bin, mpr-17933.bin; the same files whose screens XvSF's EXP-0055 recorded): 'Memory Manager', 'System Memory', 'Cartridge Memory'; 'control panel' for the BIOS screen (the user's choice). {text} is drawn cyan and [text] red, as the Japanese highlights; an empty line is a half-line gap. The fonts have no parentheses, so the Japanese '(initialize it)' is folded into the sentence.
approved: 2026-11-06, the user: "Approve the drafts (Recommended)", "control panel (Recommended)", "6, what the game checks", "Arcade font, Japanese colours (Recommended)"

title: WARNING

WARNING0.PIX.when: the game's save fails its checksum (D-048)
lines: The saved data could not be read
correctly.
If you start the game now, your
earlier data will not be used.
Press any button to start the game.
System Memory is not yet ready to
save data.
In the Sega Saturn's {Memory Manager},
clear all data in System Memory to
initialize it.
Press any button to go to the
control panel.
Cartridge Memory is not yet ready to
save data.
In the Sega Saturn's {Memory Manager},
clear all data in Cartridge Memory
to initialize it.
Press any button to go to the
control panel.
Neither System Memory nor Cartridge
Memory is ready to save data yet.
In the Sega Saturn's {Memory Manager},
clear all data in both to initialize
them.
Press any button to go to the
control panel.

WARNING4.PIX.when: no save, and too little free space (D-048)
lines: If you start the game now, your data
cannot be saved.
Saving needs [6] blocks of free space.
In the Sega Saturn's {Memory Manager},
delete other games' data or copy it
to Cartridge Memory, then restart
the game.
Press any button to start the game.
WARNING4.PIX.fix: The Japanese says 05; the game needs 6 free blocks (5 still warn, EXP-0051). The user chose the fix: "6, what the game checks".
